tierDefinitions.production-ready: independent evaluation exists and the stated limits match what it found
tierDefinitions.research-ready: measured data and a committed evaluation exist; the claimed level is not identifiable from them
tierDefinitions.experimental: implemented and internally evaluated; no independent validation exists
tierDefinitions.data-blocked: no obtainable dataset can move this feature; the block is the data's absence
tierDefinitions.unsupported: the product must not make the claim at all

features.claim: Predicted crop water use in litres per plant per day
features.measuredOn: 380 pot-days from 35 published pots, 7 treatments, 11 weighings
whatItSupports: the seasonal shape of lettuce water demand (Spearman 0.7909 across 11 days)
a per-plant, per-day water-use benchmark that any future change must be compared with
whatItDoesNotSupport: a level correction: pot-surface and canopy-area denominators reverse the sign of the discrepancy, and neither is published
a crop coefficient: no per-day trial weather exists
transpiration alone: the measurement includes substrate evaporation
features.whatWouldMoveIt: per-day weather and pot geometry for a gravimetric or lysimeter trial, so that measured ET can be divided by a reference ET0 for the same days
features.blockingEvidence: none obtainable under an open licence in this phase

features.claim: The claim that the ET0 target is itself correct
features.measuredOn: four independent reanalysis and station sources over matched days
whatItSupports: that the FAO-56 computation is implemented correctly and is stable across inputs
that the emulator reproduces the computation, not that the computation is truth
whatItDoesNotSupport: a claim that reanalysis ET0 equals on-site measurement
spatial validity below the reanalysis grid cell
features.whatWouldMoveIt: a flux-tower or lysimeter site inside a controlled environment, which is the same object measured-eta needs
features.blockingEvidence: no controlled-environment ET0 measurement exists openly

features.measuredOn: 252 hydroponic lettuce plants, 35 greenhouse lettuce pots, 20 open-field tomato plants
whatItSupports: leave-one-experiment-out lettuce harvest prediction (v2 R2 0.8699 / MAE 34.9 g)
per-plant harvest mass for two independent lettuce experiments
whatItDoesNotSupport: any controlled-environment tomato or mizuna harvest prediction
a spaceflight yield claim: no spaceflight harvest label exists in-repo
features.whatWouldMoveIt: a controlled-environment tomato or mizuna harvest trial with per-plant labels and documented conditions
features.blockingEvidence: no such open dataset was found in this phase's search

features.claim: Response to specific LED spectra and photoperiods
features.measuredOn: 252 plants across four fixed spectra at constant 200 umol/m2/s and 16 h
whatItSupports: that spectral composition can be held as a categorical factor with 48-80 plants per arm
whatItDoesNotSupport: an intensity response: PPFD was constant by design
a photoperiod response: photoperiod was constant by design
any quantitative yield model: no model consumes this table yet
features.whatWouldMoveIt: a trial varying PPFD and photoperiod independently, or a model that consumes the existing table with leave-one-spectrum-out evaluation
features.blockingEvidence: the photoperiod half of the claim has no dataset at all

features.claim: Effect of Mars or lunar gravity on crop growth
features.measuredOn: nothing: no fractional-gravity plant growth dataset exists in this repository
whatItSupports: a bounded response curve whose sensitivity coefficient is a modelling assumption
whatItDoesNotSupport: any quantitative Mars- or lunar-gravity yield prediction
the conflation of clinostat, ground analog and spaceflight data, none of which is present
features.whatWouldMoveIt: a fractional-gravity growth experiment; none exists openly at the replication needed
features.blockingEvidence: no open dataset; a measurement to commission, not to download

features.claim: Root-zone water status in a hydroponic or substrate system
features.measuredOn: nothing: no root-zone water-potential series exists in-repo. The Schroeder trial's water-holding-capacity sheet is a static substrate property, not a root-zone time series.
whatItSupports: a single well-mixed root-zone water store with a recovery efficiency assumption
whatItDoesNotSupport: substrate matric potential, oxygen status, or root-zone gradients
features.whatWouldMoveIt: a substrate water-potential series logged alongside a growth trial
features.blockingEvidence: the acquisition that came closest (water holding capacity) measures capacity, not status

features.measuredOn: hourly reanalysis and station records at grid and station resolution
whatItSupports: hourly VPD and temperature trajectories for siting and for ET0 input
whatItDoesNotSupport: canopy-level excursions inside a controlled environment
any statement about a facility's internal climate
features.whatWouldMoveIt: in-facility climate logging at sub-hourly resolution
features.blockingEvidence: no open controlled-environment climate series with the required resolution was found

features.measuredOn: three crop profiles (lettuce, tomato, radish) with no cultivar field
whatItSupports: a species-level parameter set explicitly documented as not cultivar-resolved
whatItDoesNotSupport: any cultivar-specific prediction, and no dataset in-repo carries a cultivar label usable as a model input
features.whatWouldMoveIt: two or more cultivars of one species grown under identical conditions
features.blockingEvidence: the lettuce experiments in-repo each use a single unnamed cultivar

features.claim: Plant health or growth stage from imagery
features.measuredOn: nothing: the tomato trial ships an RGB leaf-area series, which is a measurement derived from imagery rather than the imagery itself
whatItSupports: nothing: the product does not claim an imagery model
whatItDoesNotSupport: any computer-vision claim, health classification, or growth-stage detection
features.whatWouldMoveIt: paired imagery and destructive harvest from the same plants
features.blockingEvidence: the class E/F imagery datasets in the catalogue cannot be used under their licences or do not match the task

features.claim: Energy and mass cost of a described mission
features.measuredOn: nothing: energy per LED-hour and per litre is a deterministic calculation over stated assumptions, not a measurement
whatItSupports: a reproducible accounting of lighting and pumping energy under stated assumptions
whatItDoesNotSupport: a validated mission energy budget, and any comparison against a real facility
features.whatWouldMoveIt: metered energy data from an operating controlled-environment facility
features.blockingEvidence: no metered facility energy dataset is openly available

features.measuredOn: row-level shoot and fruit nutrient uptake with solution concentrations and a recycled-solution fraction; not yet preprocessed
whatItSupports: that a nutrient-uptake prior is constructible from a licensed, acquired source
whatItDoesNotSupport: any per-plant nutrient claim: replication is at row level
a closed nutrient balance: the sheet reports uptake, not depletion and replenishment
features.whatWouldMoveIt: preprocessing the acquired workbook into a tidy table and evaluating a nutrient prior against it with row-level folds
features.blockingEvidence: row-level replication caps the inference, and the product makes no nutrient claim today

features.claim: Siting for a future climate rather than the observed recent past
features.measuredOn: nothing acquired: the CMIP6 downscaled product is catalogued at class D and was not downloaded
whatItSupports: nothing: no siting-for-future-climate claim is made
whatItDoesNotSupport: any projection-based recommendation
features.whatWouldMoveIt: acquiring the downscaled projections and defining a projection-based ET0 target with an explicit scenario
features.blockingEvidence: the product's ET0 target is the observed recent past by construction
